ValidationRule.description: US-23/US-30: a lead can only be converted once its Visit Purpose is set; the Vehicle of Interest is needed only when the conversion creates a sale (an enquiry converted without an opportunity is kept as a customer record).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( IsConverted, OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Visit_Purpose__c)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(ConvertedOpportunityId)), ISBLANK(Vehicle_Model_Of_Interest__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cancel, then fill in on the lead itself (the Contacted step on the path): Visit Purpose, and for a sale the Vehicle of Interest. For an enquiry only, tick "Don't create an opportunity" instead.
